moments.action: A hand shades a sketched car over lined class notes; the dark-haired student stares down at the page, then the film cuts away to the teacher working equations at the whiteboard.
Outside, a student carries a loaded food tray through the crowd; a whip-pan across blonde hair opens onto a pep rally - players in purple jerseys up on a truck bed under signs and a mascot effigy.

The dark-haired teen stands in the rally crowd with a grinning blond kid in headphones at his shoulder; cheerleaders and DUCK FOOTBALL placards fill the frame, then he is alone in close-up as students file past.
Credits run over two long out-of-focus macro shots - a smear of red and chrome, then a soft blue wash. Neither image ever resolves, carrying the picture off the school exteriors.

Auto shop: seen past a lift, boys scuffle by the green lockers while the dark-haired teen works a wrench at a tan race car and the instructor slumps at his desk; by the last shot the teen is on his feet, looking off.

Three boys pin a classmate to a roller door and haul his shirt up to scrawl a purple mark on his bare stomach; the cuts tighten from the dark-haired teen's stare to the mark and back to his hardened face.
A hand slides open a tool drawer and lifts out jumper-cable clamps; the camera holds on the back of the teen's head as he turns, and across the shop a hand is now clamped over the pinned boy's mouth.
Out in the student lot, players in purple jerseys load up between trucks; the angle reverses to the back of the dark-haired teen's head as he halts beside a red convertible and looks across the cars.

chars: the blond girl in the floral top
moments.action: A blond girl perches on the back of the convertible working her phone; the camera pans down her bare legs and back up, and on the last shot she lifts her eyes off the phone straight into the lens.
The teen crosses the lot to a tan muscle car as students stream past; the angle flips over the girl's shoulder to a line of purple-jerseyed players closing in, the blond in number 13 at the centre.

chars: the blond girl in the floral top
moments.action: She turns and smiles back over her shoulder; he holds her look, mouth easing into a half-smile, and the last shot stays on her as the grin widens.
